Production photo (Marina Part 2 160-169 s, the set): vanity wall, the window wall (lace swag valance + lace panels), the prints/towel-bar wall, the curved tub with a black-framed quadrant shower in the corner, the toilet beside the door. Marina 205-228 s (her CG walk) and her overhead (0:50) agree on the wall each sits on.
